hooks.text: While you hustle, a 5‑second animation hustles for you.
Posting daily? Stop—your time’s wasted, automation does the work.
Most owners post once, then disappear; animated ads never sleep.

posts.instagram:
Aap kaam mein busy hain, par ek 5-second ki animation scroll rok sakti hai.

Roz naye graphics banate rehna kisi bhi business owner ke liye mushkil hota hai—chahe bakery ho, clinic ya repair service. Static image par log rukte nahi, scroll karke nikal jaate hain. Motion screen par dhyan kheenchta hai.

Main simple 5-10 second AI animated ads design karta hoon: clear offer, clean movement, aur seedha WhatsApp ya call ka prompt. Ek focused ad se regular enquiries aana aasan ho sakta hai, bina daily posting ke jhanjhat ke.

Pricing: INR 999 / 1,499 / 2,199. You pay only after you approve the work.

DM 'ADS' aur batayein aap kya sell karte hain. Main batata hoon ye aapke setup ke liye sahi hai ya nahi.

#SmallBusinessIndia #IndianEntrepreneurs #LocalBusinessIndia #SmallBusinessTips
posts.linkedin:
While you hustle with customers, a 5-second animation can do the talking online.

Most small business owners do not have hours every day to design social posts. Whether you run a clinic, a gym, or an auto workshop, your real hours go into servicing clients.

The challenge with static images is simple: people scroll right past them. Motion changes that. A short 5-to-10 second animated loop catches the eye just long enough to deliver one clear message.

When I build AI animated ads for small businesses, I keep the structure focused:
1. A clear hook stating the offer.
2. Subtle motion that cuts through feed fatigue.
3. A direct prompt to message on WhatsApp or call.

A single scheduled ad running quietly in the background can bring consistent enquiries without the pressure of posting every morning.

Pricing is INR 999 / 1,499 / 2,199. You pay only after you approve the work.

DM 'ADS' and tell me what you sell. I'll tell you honestly what kind of ad would suit your business.
